page.overview:
Who is Almiel?

Almiel was the third child of Tar-Meneldur and the younger sister of Ailinel and Tar-Aldarion.

Almiel was born between SA 700 and SA 750 in the Númenórean province of Forostar. She had two other siblings: Anardil, who would later become the sixth King of Númenor, ruling as Tar-Aldarion, and an older sister named Ailinel. Little to nothing else is known about her.

The name Almiel might be related to the Quenya term alma ("good fortune") and -iel a feminine patronymic suffix.
